title.zh: 将拉乌尼翁省阿戈奥市镇的圣曼努埃尔北国立中学更名为Manuel T. Cases Sr.博士国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of San Manuel Norte National High School in the Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union to Dr. Manuel T. Cases Sr. National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of San Manuel Norte National High School in the Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union to Dr. Manuel T. Cases Sr. National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia San Manuel Norte tại Thị trấn Agoo, Tỉnh La Union thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Dr. Manuel T. Cases Sr.
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ San Manuel Norte ในเทศบาล Agoo, จังหวัด La Union เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Dr. Manuel T. Cases Sr.
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional San Manuel Norte di Kotamadya Agoo, Provinsi La Union menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Dr. Manuel T. Cases Sr.
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan San Manuel Norte di Perbandaran Agoo, Wilayah La Union menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Dr. Manuel T. Cases Sr.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10746_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Renaming of a National High School. — The name of San Manuel Norte National High School in the Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union is hereby changed to Dr. Manuel T. Cases Sr. National High School.
Location of the Main Campus. — The main campus of the Dr. Manuel T. Cases Sr. National High School shall continue to remain in its present location in the Municipality of Agoo, Province of La Union.
Effectivity. — This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
